items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: And I noticed that 'Don't Play Me Cheap is written by you and Harry Dial Dew. [INTERVIEWEE] Yes, uh-huh, 'Don't Play Me -- that's right.

ctx.x: I believe so. Because Sid didn't go out on the road with us. We had a fellow - when Yank Porter
left us, we had a fellow by the name of -- he's in New York, now -- by the name of Harry Dial Dew.
Oh, yes, Harry Dial Dow. Well, now, you mentioned him when you were in St. Louis.
